load_squad_metric: load the squad evaluation module using evaluate.load with the metric name
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for the squad evaluation module
compute_squad_metrics: compute squad metrics including exact match and f1 score on predictions and references
combine_evaluation_modules: combine multiple evaluation modules into a single CombinedEvaluations object
list_evaluation_modules: list all available evaluation modules in the evaluate library
